title: Map config
description: Which layers to build, and the map's view, basemap, title and number locale: your git-ignored map.config.yaml, or the committed map.pages.yaml for the GitHub Pages copy. Every key is optional. Design note 04.

view.description: Where the map opens (center and zoom, unless the URL says otherwise), and how far it can zoom and pan.

minzoom.description: The furthest out the map can zoom. Not above maxzoom.

maxzoom.description: The furthest in the map can zoom.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] in degrees: the map cannot be panned outside them.

title.description: The map's name, shown as the page title. Default ERAP Map.

locale.description: The locale numbers are formatted in (a BCP 47 language tag such as en-CA or fr-CA). Default en-CA. The app's own text is not translated.

basemap.description: The basemap the map opens on.

layers.description: The layers to build. Default every layer.

overrides.description: Per layer, `source` and `processing` settings that replace the layer file's, such as a different source or a lower max zoom.

require.description: Layers whose source must exist: the build fails rather than skip them.

layerName.description: A layer name: its file name without .yaml.
